All verification passed. Let me summarize my work.

Documentation completed for all 11 assigned files in `cli/src/`:

| File | Docs added |
|---|---|
| `normalize.rs` | 38 — `DumpRow` fields, constructors, `dedup_key`, `CSV_HEADER`, `csv_line`, `escape_csv_field`; module doc covering date/status/document/quantity normalization and stable field order |
| `config.rs` | 27 — `RawAccount`/`Defaults`/`CliConfig` fields and methods; module doc covering TOML shape, multi-account config, credential exclusivity, `0600` permission guidance |
| `selfupdate.rs` | 25 — `REPO`, `UpdateOptions`/`Plan` fields and functions; module doc covering release tag/checksum/sha256/atomic install flow and env overrides |
| `dump/mod.rs` | 23 — `DumpOptions`/`DumpError`/`DedupRecord` fields, `run`, `parse_date`; module doc covering window segmentation, sorted rows `(account, system, numero, barcode)`, dedup key, `relatorio.json`, resume state |
| `account.rs` | 22 — `Account` fields/methods, `load_accounts`; module doc covering priority mapping and session-token reuse |
| `error.rs` | 10 — `CliError` variants and `exit_code`; module doc and per-variant exit codes (2/3/4/5/6/7/1) |
| `batch.rs` | 10 — `BatchOp`/`BatchOptions` fields; module doc covering JSONL protocol and result/error shape |
| `runtime.rs` | 6 — `Runtime` fields, `load`, `resolve`; module doc |
| `params.rs` | 5 — all conversion functions; module doc |
| `migrate.rs` | 5 — `MigrateOutcome` fields; module doc |
| `output.rs` | 1 — `print_json` |

All docs are in Portuguese, describe integrator-relevant contracts, and intra-doc links use fully-qualified `crate::` paths (resolved by module-level docs).

- `cargo rustc -p open-mtr-cli --lib -- -W missing_docs`: **zero** warnings in any of my files.
- `RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p open-mtr-cli --no-deps`: **zero** errors referencing my files. (One remaining pre-existing error: missing crate docs in `cli/src/main.rs`, which is outside my assigned set.)
- `cargo check -p open-mtr-cli --lib`: passes.
- All changes are doc comments only; no code, signatures, attributes, behaviour or tests were modified. `cli/src/cli/mod.rs` and `cli/src/lib.rs` were not touched.
